terra.problem: The text does not say the basket was floating or that it was the only thing floating there.
Saying the sister stayed far enough away not to draw attention adds a reason the text does not give.
Pharaoh’s daughter identifies the baby as Hebrew. The text does not say she knew whose baby he was.
The text does not say Pharaoh’s daughter knew the baby was not from an Egyptian family. It says she identified him as a Hebrew child.
The text does not say the mother knew the baby best or describe a walk back to the river.
The text does not place the whole passage at the Nile or say there was no sand.
The text does not say everything in the passage happens at the river.
